text: This function correctly determines whether a given Gregorian year is a leap year. It first checks if the year is divisible by 4, which is a necessary condition for a year to be a leap year. If it is, it then checks if the year is also divisible by 100, in which case it must also be divisible by 400 to be a leap year. This implementation accurately reflects the rules for determining leap years in the Gregorian calendar. The function returns True if the year is a leap year and False otherwise.
